title: NutEV Reference Engine: taxonomy-guided reference discovery and ranking for Lifestyle Nutrition
description: NutEV Reference Engine is an open-source software tool for multi-source discovery, normalization, deduplication and prioritization of references in Lifestyle Nutrition research. It combines bibliographic and institutional sources with the NutEV keyword taxonomy and configurable focus terms to produce a ranked reading/reference queue. Ranking reflects information-retrieval priority and does not represent scientific inclusion/exclusion or a clinical recommendation.
